title: Create Binary Tree From Descriptions
goal: Construct the binary tree described by parent child and side triples.
strategy: Create one node per value and attach each edge to its specified side. The unique value that never appears as a child is the root.

phasePurposes.start: Construct the binary tree described by parent child and side triples.
phasePurposes.inspect: Create one node per value and attach each edge to its specified side. The unique value that never appears as a child is the root.
phasePurposes.update: Create one node per value and attach each edge to its specified side. The unique value that never appears as a child is the root.
phasePurposes.done: Construct the binary tree described by parent child and side triples.

edgeCases: One edge forms the smallest described tree
A right-only chain preserves null left positions
The root need not be the smallest or first parent
